mentions.story: Housing can’t both be a good investment and be affordable
mentions.why: Renter and buyer end up with similar net worth over 25 years.
mentions.quote: The TL;DW is that if you compare a renter & a buyer from day 1 to the end of a 25 year mortgage, both the renter and owner will have roughly the same net worth.
